svg.aria-label: The seven overlapping frameworks every US federal LLM deployment must satisfy, with NIST AI RMF as the cross-cutting voluntary baseline.
svg.text: Seven overlapping frameworks for US federal LLM deployments (plus NIST AI RMF as voluntary baseline)
Civilian agency AI policy; rights-impacting vs safety-impacting classification; public inventory listing
Cloud service authorization; FedRAMP Marketplace is the source of truth; 9-18 mo + $1-3M provider investment
3. Government cloud tiers: AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Government Cloud
Frontier LLM availability varies; Bedrock GovCloud + Azure OpenAI GCC High at FedRAMP High
Streaming-text UI, screen-reader compatibility, keyboard nav, alt-text, color contrast
5. EU AI Act Annex III (public services, law enforcement, justice)
Conformity assessment; post-market monitoring; ~4-8 mo pre-market + 0.5-1.5 FTE/yr ongoing
NYC Local Law 144, WA algo rules, CA AB-2930, Colorado AI Act (effective Feb 2026)
7. Public-records / sunshine laws (FOIA, state open-records, FERPA, HIPAA)
Chatbot transcripts are records; retention schedules and FOIA-response capability in logging arch
